summary.text: Teddy Collins is the Republican candidate for the Colorado State Senate, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Justin Kurth.
Collins is the founder and operator of Spartan Defense Armory & Training.

paragraphs.text: Teddy Collins advanced from the Republican primary for Colorado State Senate District 4 on June 30, 2026, receiving 25,665 votes in an uncontested primary.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Collins described himself as an entrepreneur and small business owner, the owner of one of Colorado's largest family-owned firearms businesses, and a father of two with a third child on the way.
He listed his campaign's key messages as affordability, defending the Second Amendment and constitutional rights, public safety and school security, and parental rights and education.
His stated priorities include defending TABOR, stopping new taxes and fees, reducing regulations, and opposing restrictions on lawful gun owners.
